overview: The committee discussed a proposal to authorize a 20-year contract for solar panel installation at McGlynn School to secure federal tax credits. The council reviewed the financial benefits of a power purchase agreement versus ownership and referred the matter to the regular meeting.

items.title: Authorization of contract period for McGlynn School solar panels
items.summary: Referred the request for a 20-year contract with Select Energy to the regular meeting following a discussion on energy cost savings, federal tax credit deadlines, and roof maintenance liability. Councilors requested a detailed cost analysis comparing leasing to ownership before the final vote.
